stories.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon can hunt bugs and run engineering tasks for days
stories.blurb: Google just released Gemini 4 Carbon, a new frontier model that tops benchmarks for finding security vulnerabilities and generating secure code. It beat Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra on several tests, and Google says internal teams have watched it run for days straight on complex multi-step engineering work without shortcuts or getting derailed by prompt injection.
stories.why_it_matters: A model that can autonomously debug and secure code for days changes what engineers can delegate.
stories.original_headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity

stories.headline: Mistral just open-sourced a 1-trillion-parameter coding and security model
stories.blurb: Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk) is now fully open-weight after three weeks of additional training pushed it to the top of coding benchmarks. The trillion-parameter model leads open models in coding and cybersecurity tasks, offers three reasoning modes to balance cost and performance, and runs entirely on European infrastructure for organizations that need data sovereignty.
stories.why_it_matters: A frontier model you can download, customize, and run yourself just became the best open option for code.
stories.original_headline: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.

stories.headline: DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion
stories.blurb: The deal combines America's largest restaurant delivery app with its biggest grocery delivery platform. DoorDash gets Instacart's 600,000 shoppers and relationships with every major supermarket chain, while Instacart users get access to restaurant delivery in a single app.
stories.why_it_matters: One company will now control most of what Americans order to their door.
stories.original_headline: DoorDash to Buy Instacart for $17 Billion, Uniting 2 Delivery Giants

stories.headline: Wabi now builds mini apps on the fly as your AI assistant
stories.blurb: Wabi, founded by Replika's Eugenia Kuyda, just raised $55M at a $1.25B valuation after pivoting from a prompt-to-app builder into an AI messenger that generates custom interfaces on demand. Think meal planners, restaurant trackers, or trivia games built in chat as you need them.
stories.why_it_matters: Another bet that the future of AI isn't a text box — it's apps that write themselves.
stories.original_headline: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round

stories.headline: AI is finding so many bugs that engineers can't fix them fast enough
stories.blurb: AI tools are now discovering security flaws faster than development teams can patch them, creating a new bottleneck in software security. Engineers across Silicon Valley are racing to prioritize and fix vulnerabilities before hackers can exploit them.
stories.why_it_matters: The bug-finding bottleneck has shifted from discovery to remediation.
stories.original_headline: AI Is Finding a Flood of Bugs, and Silicon Valley Is Rushing to Fix Them

try_this_prompt.title: The negotiation floor
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'm about to negotiate something I'll describe below. Don't give me tactics or scripts. Instead: tell me the worst deal I could accept and still walk away feeling fine in six months, then tell me the one thing I'm probably overvaluing that the other side doesn't care about at all.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: Before you counter-offer on salary, contracts, or splitting equity.
